name: Jest of the Burning Wind
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target: One creature

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn gains a +2 bonus, and the target cannot benefit from cover or concealment until the end of your next turn.
